title: Cardiovascular Stent & TAVI Frames
description: Thin-strut lattice/expanding cage structure (struts 0.1-0.5mm), crimped delivery configuration, self-expanding or balloon-expandable
designPrinciples: Material: Nitinol (Ni-Ti shape memory alloy) provides the unique superelasticity required for self-expanding stents and TAVI frames. The alloy undergoes martensitic transformation at body temperature.
Form: Nitinol begins as precision-ground tube (OD 1-8mm). Laser cutting of the stent pattern, followed by shape-setting heat treatment and electropolishing.
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM F2063 Nitinol, superelastic condition, Af 25+-3C, 100% dimensional + corrosion testing, sterile packaged
